- 12 User Needs
- 9 Functional Requirements
- 7 Non-Functional Requirements
- 13 User Stories

[Iteration 1] Generated requirements specification:
- 12 User Needs
- 15 Functional Requirements
- 7 Non-Functional Requirements
- 22 User Stories

user_needs.user_need: I need to access current football news and live results for my favorite teams so that I can stay informed at all times.
user_needs.user_journey: User opens the app, selects favorite teams, and views news and live results on the dashboard.

user_needs.user_need: I need to personalize my app experience by selecting favorite teams and sports channels.
user_needs.user_journey: User configures preferences during onboarding or in settings to tailor content.

user_needs.user_need: I need to receive real-time notifications about news and results for my favorite teams.
user_needs.user_journey: User enables notifications and receives push alerts for relevant events.

user_needs.user_need: I need to access live stream links for matches when available and permitted in my country.
user_needs.user_journey: User browses match details and clicks on live stream links when rights are available.

user_needs.user_need: I need to view detailed team and player information at any time.
user_needs.user_journey: User searches or navigates to team/player profiles for in-depth stats and info.

user_needs.user_need: I need to share news and game reports via social media directly from the app.
user_needs.user_journey: User reads an article or report and uses the share function to post on social media.

user_needs.user_need: I need to register and log in quickly and easily at app startup.
user_needs.user_journey: User downloads the app, registers or logs in with minimal steps, and accesses main features.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to load and be ready to use within two seconds after starting.
user_needs.user_journey: User launches the app and expects immediate access to content.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to function reliably even with limited network coverage and remain usable offline.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses the app in areas with poor connectivity and expects core features to work.

user_needs.user_need: I need assurance that my personal data is protected and processed in compliance with GDPR.
user_needs.user_journey: User registers and uses the app, expecting privacy and data protection.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to remain stable and performant even during high-traffic events such as match days.
user_needs.user_journey: User accesses the app during peak times and expects no slowdowns or crashes.

user_needs.user_need: I need the app to be available on both Android and iOS devices.
user_needs.user_journey: User downloads and installs the app from the respective app store.

functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall allow users to select and follow their favorite football teams and sports channels.
The system shall display current football news relevant to the user's selected favorite teams and channels.
The system shall provide a live ticker module that retrieves and displays live results for the user's favorite teams in real time.
The system shall provide detailed team and player information accessible at any time.
The system shall integrate live stream links for matches, displaying them only when transmission rights are fulfilled in the user's country.
The system shall allow users to share news articles and game reports via social media platforms directly from the app.
The system shall provide a notification system that sends real-time alerts about news and results for the user's favorite teams when notifications are enabled.
The system shall provide registration and login functionality that can be completed directly at app startup with minimal steps.
The system shall ensure that all modules and the user interface remain consistent and operational even when external server updates occur.
The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, live ticker data, and team/player information, and shall cache this data for offline use.

The system shall store user personalization data (favorite teams, channels, notification preferences) securely in the cloud and locally, and shall synchronize preferences across devices when the user is logged in.
The system shall allow users to customize notification preferences by event type (e.g., goals, news, match start/end, all events).
The system shall support sharing to at least Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and Instagram, and shall use native app integration or deep linking where available.
The system shall determine user location and verify streaming rights for live content before displaying live stream links.
The system shall support registration and login via email/password and third-party authentication providers (Google, Apple, Facebook).

non_functional_requirements.requirement: The system shall load and be fully ready for user interaction within two seconds of app launch.
The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall function reliably with limited network coverage and provide offline access to previously loaded content.
The system shall process and store all personal data in compliance with GDPR.
The system shall be available for both Android and iOS platforms.
The system shall undergo unit, integration, load, and user acceptance testing before release, and shall provide in-app support and a help center for users.
The system shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality, with a feedback mechanism available in the app.

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to select my favorite teams and sports channels so that I receive personalized news and live results.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in and on the preferences screen
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects teams and channels and saves preferences
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays news and live results relevant to the selected teams and channels

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to view current news about my favorite teams so that I stay informed.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has selected favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the news section
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays news articles relevant to the user's favorite teams

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to follow live results for my favorite teams so that I can track matches in real time.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has selected favorite teams
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the live ticker module
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays real-time match results for those teams

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to access detailed team and player information so that I can learn more about them.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the team or player section
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects a team or player
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays detailed information about the selected team or player

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to access live stream links for matches when available and permitted in my country so that I can watch live games.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Viewing live stream link when rights are available
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a match with available streaming rights in their country
acceptance_criteria.when: the live broadcast has begun
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays the live stream link for the match

acceptance_criteria.scenario: No live stream link when rights are not available
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a match without streaming rights in their country
acceptance_criteria.when: the live broadcast has begun
acceptance_criteria.then: the app does not display the live stream link

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to share news and game reports via social media so that I can inform my friends.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a news article or game report
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the share button and selects a social media platform
acceptance_criteria.then: the app shares the content to the selected platform

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to receive real-time notifications about news and results for my favorite teams so that I never miss important updates.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has enabled notifications
acceptance_criteria.when: a relevant news or result update occurs
acceptance_criteria.then: the app sends a push notification to the user

user_stories.user_story: As a football fan, I want to register and log in quickly at app startup so that I can access the app's features immediately.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has just installed the app
acceptance_criteria.when: the user opens the app for the first time
acceptance_criteria.then: the app presents a simple registration/login process and grants access to main features

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to load and be ready to use within two seconds so that I can access information quickly.

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is installed on a supported device
acceptance_criteria.when: the user launches the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app is fully loaded and interactive within two seconds

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to function reliably even with limited network coverage so that I can use it offline.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Offline access to previously loaded content
acceptance_criteria.given: the user has previously loaded content and loses network connection
acceptance_criteria.when: the user navigates the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays cached content and remains usable

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want assurance that my personal data is protected and processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy is respected.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user registers and uses the app
acceptance_criteria.when: personal data is processed or stored
acceptance_criteria.then: the app processes data according to GDPR requirements

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to remain stable and performant even during high-traffic events so that I can use it without issues.

acceptance_criteria.given: there are up to 100,000 concurrent users
acceptance_criteria.when: users access the app during peak times
acceptance_criteria.then: the app remains stable and responsive

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to download and use the app on both Android and iOS devices so that I can access it on my preferred platform.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user searches for the app in the app store
acceptance_criteria.when: the user downloads and installs the app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app is available and functional on both Android and iOS devices

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want all modules and the user interface to remain consistent and operational even when external server updates occur so that I have a reliable experience.

acceptance_criteria.given: the external server is updated
acceptance_criteria.when: the user accesses the app
acceptance_criteria.then: all modules and the user interface remain consistent and operational

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to access previously loaded news, live ticker data, and team/player information offline so that I can use the app without a network connection.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has previously loaded news, live ticker data, and team/player information
acceptance_criteria.when: the device is offline
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays cached news, live ticker data, and team/player information

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want my personalization data to be synchronized across devices so that my preferences are always up to date.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is logged in on multiple devices
acceptance_criteria.when: the user updates preferences on one device
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated preferences are reflected on all devices

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to customize which types of notifications I receive so that I only get alerts that matter to me.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the notification settings screen
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects or deselects notification types
acceptance_criteria.then: the app sends only the selected types of notifications

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to share news and game reports to Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and Instagram so that I can reach my friends on my preferred platform.

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Sharing to supported social media platforms
acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a news article or game report
acceptance_criteria.when: the user taps the share button and selects a supported platform
acceptance_criteria.then: the app shares the content using native integration or deep linking

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to see live stream links only when streaming rights are available in my country so that I comply with legal requirements.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is viewing a match
acceptance_criteria.when: the app checks user location and streaming rights
acceptance_criteria.then: the live stream link is displayed only if rights are available in the user's country

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to register and log in using email/password or third-party providers so that I can choose my preferred authentication method.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is on the registration/login screen
acceptance_criteria.when: the user selects Google, Apple, Facebook, or email/password
acceptance_criteria.then: the app completes registration/login using the selected method

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want the app to undergo thorough testing and have access to in-app support and a help center so that I can get help and trust the app's quality.

acceptance_criteria.given: the app is released to users
acceptance_criteria.when: the user encounters an issue or seeks help
acceptance_criteria.then: the app has undergone unit, integration, load, and UAT testing, and provides in-app support and a help center

user_stories.user_story: As a user, I want to provide feedback and reviews within the app so that my input can help improve the app.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is using the app
acceptance_criteria.when: the user accesses the feedback mechanism
acceptance_criteria.then: the user can submit feedback or reviews, and the app collects and evaluates this input

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Offline Functionality Scope
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: The requirements now specify that news, live ticker data, and team/player information are available offline if previously loaded, and that data is cached for offline use. However, the cache refresh/update policy (e.g., how often data is refreshed, how long it is stored) is not defined.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Define cache refresh intervals, expiration policies, and user controls for clearing or updating cached data.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Personalization Data Storage
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Personalization data is now specified to be stored both locally and in the cloud, with cross-device sync when logged in. The encryption and privacy measures for this data are not detailed.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Specify encryption standards and privacy controls for personalization data at rest and in transit.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Notification Preferences Granularity
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Users can now customize notification types (e.g., goals, news, match start/end, all events). The UI/UX for managing these preferences is not described.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Provide wireframes or detailed UI/UX requirements for notification settings management.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Social Media Integration Scope
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Supported platforms (Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Instagram) and use of native integration/deep linking are now specified. The handling of failed shares or platform authentication is not described.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Define error handling and fallback behavior for failed social media shares or missing platform authentication.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Live Stream Rights Management
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: The app now determines user location and verifies streaming rights before displaying links. The technical method for location determination (e.g., IP, GPS) and the rights data source are not specified.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Clarify the technical approach for location detection and the integration method for streaming rights data.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: User Registration Methods
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: Registration/login via email/password and third-party providers (Google, Apple, Facebook) is now included. The process for linking multiple authentication methods to a single account is not described.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Specify account linking and recovery flows for users with multiple authentication methods.

gaps_and_recommendations.title: Testing and Support Process Details
gaps_and_recommendations.observation: The requirements now specify unit, integration, load, and UAT testing, and in-app support/help center. The SLAs for support response and the process for handling critical bugs are not defined.
gaps_and_recommendations.recommendation: Define support SLAs, escalation procedures, and critical bug handling processes.

input: We are currently developing a mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices. It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting. With our app, we want to offer football fans a central platform where they can stay comprehensively informed at all times. To achieve this, users can display current football news of their favorite teams and also select preferred sports channels individually. In addition to the news, users can follow the results of their favorite teams live via a live ticker. Our app will offer extensive coverage of all leagues and competitions, both national and international. Detailed team and player information will also be available at any time. Another highlight is the integration of live stream links, for example, from providers such as DAZN or Sky Sport. These are available directly in the app as soon as the live broadcast has begun. Of course, it is ensured that compliance with transmission rights is maintained. Live streams will only be displayed when the respective rights are fulfilled in the country. The LiveFootball app should also give users the option to retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time. To implement this function, the app includes an integrated live ticker module that enables the retrieval and display of live data in real time. The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly. The user interface is a key component of the app and connects various modules that are displayed together and managed via the interface. The live ticker module communicates directly via the interface with the user interface to display and continuously update current match data. The live data is retrieved via an API from an external server. The server is located outside the app and provides the data dynamically so that the live ticker module can access it flexibly. In addition to the live ticker module, the app also offers additional modules that allow users to individually configure the app and connect their own interface to the user interface. Furthermore, the app is linked to a notification system that provides users with information about current events as soon as the notification function is activated. All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates. Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated and can be completed directly at app startup. Users have the option to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs and receiving notifications about news or results of their favorite teams. In addition, users can share news and game reports via social media directly from the app. We are aware that many mobile apps have to operate under difficult conditions. Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage. The app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection. On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss. To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early. In addition, user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality. Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR.
